authority.precedence: The continuous and closure goals supersede the trial addendum's Git lifecycle for the formalization and certification phases; the base technical and scope requirements remain authoritative.

publicEntryAndApi.featureRule: Feature code consumes public UI modules through @/components/ui/* and must not observe Radix or CVA implementation types.

contract: 44px effective target for default interactive use
loading exposes busy state and suppresses activation
icon-only use requires an accessible name
generated or supplied ids connect control, help, and error
decorative and semantic orientation remain explicit
current page and total pages are explicit
previous and next controls have accessible names
pagination region has an accessible name
disabled boundary controls remain native buttons
ConfirmDialog is the VanStro high-level confirmation API
async confirmation rejection keeps the dialog open and renders role=alert
errorMessage may be content or an unknown-error formatter
onConfirmError receives unknown without owning business error interpretation

dataSlot.rule: Every public component and rendered public Dialog part renders a stable data-slot on its semantic outer element; DialogPortal and DialogRoot are the non-rendering public-part exemptions because the Radix portal renders no semantic outer element and DialogRoot is a context provider that renders no element. DialogOverlay and DialogContent remain required to render data-slot=dialog-overlay and data-slot=dialog-content. The exemptions must not add a DOM wrapper; slots identify component parts, not business state.

aliases.--ui-font-sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

rules: Do not duplicate brand color literals
The literal --ui-font-sans stack is the sole exception because it exactly matches the established body typography stack
The existing variables remain the only visual color, radius, and shadow token source

cssCoexistence.legacyCss: Existing CSS remains unlayered, unmoved, unformatted, and unchanged except for the approved top-level Tailwind/token wiring.
cssCoexistence.compatibilitySelectorRule: Only single .vs-ui-* class selectors; no element, feature, legacy, compound, id, or !important selectors.

singleStyleAuthority.ButtonAndBadgeVariants: CVA-emitted .vs-ui-*-<variant> classes are the sole visual selectors; data-variant remains state metadata only.
singleStyleAuthority.FormControlInvalidState: Input, Textarea, Select, and Checkbox use [aria-invalid=true] as the sole invalid-state visual selector; data-invalid remains state metadata only.

dependencyBoundary.futureDependencyRule: Popover, Tooltip, Dropdown, Command, Select, and other headless dependencies require a real consumer and a new contract authorization.

renderingBoundaries.ssr: Components must emit deterministic server markup without accessing browser globals during render.
renderingBoundaries.staticExport: The library and owned QA fixture must remain compatible with the current Next.js static-export chain.
renderingBoundaries.rsc: Modules are server-compatible by default; add use client only to the smallest module requiring state, effects, event handlers, refs, or a client-only third-party primitive.
client: Dialog implementation is a client boundary
Interactive controls may be client boundaries only where their behavior requires it
Pure variant modules and cn remain client-directive-free
renderingBoundaries.hydration: Dialog portal and controlled/uncontrolled states must not produce hydration mismatch.

general: Keyboard operation and visible focus are required
Disabled and loading states remain perceivable
Errors are associated with their controls
status: StatusMessage chooses status or alert intentionally
LiveRegion supports polite/assertive and atomic behavior
contentStates: Skeleton and EmptyState include screen-reader text

visualFreeze.design: Use current VanStro tokens and Chinese desktop density; UI-0 grants no redesign authority.
visualFreeze.existingPages: Existing page screenshots, DOM, accessibility behavior, and static artifacts must remain equivalent to the accepted S02 baseline.
visualFreeze.failureRule: Any unexplained visible difference blocks formalization.

rollbackAndDeprecation.rollback: Because adoption is zero, rollback removes the candidate UI/config/QA files and reverts only the approved package, lockfile, and globals.css candidate deltas after explicit authorization.
rollbackAndDeprecation.deprecation: After formalization, a stable public export or variant is not removed or renamed silently; publish a replacement and migration window, migrate all consumers, then remove under a separately authorized contract.
rollbackAndDeprecation.breakingChange: Token aliases, data-slot values, public names, prop semantics, and variant values are contract surface.

zeroPageAdoption.fixtureRule: The browser fixture is owned QA infrastructure and must not be placed under src/app or alter product/static routes.

futurePackageExtraction.currentDecision: Do not create packages/ui in UI-0.
conditions: More than one application has real consumers of the same stable primitives
The public API and token contract have remained stable through measured adoption
The package can remain free of application Auth, Observability, API, P02, and business-state coupling
RSC/client boundaries and CSS delivery work across every consuming application
A migration plan preserves import and visual contracts
Independent contract, build, static-export, browser, accessibility, rollback, and deprecation gates are approved

rules: not exported from the new barrel
direct-import and lowercase-filename guards explicitly exempt only these entries
